description: Governed classification map for tables discovered in sql/cbs.sql. Entries may be extended after inventory review; unknown tables default to review_required.

appear.notes: Episode-to-cast relationship table. episode_id and cast_id are identity-bearing; copied episode title/date fields are corroborating only.

episode.notes: Legacy episode table, when present, is compared against data/episodes.json and used to identify fields missing from the JSON export.

cast.notes: Legacy cast/person table, when present, is compared against data/cast.json.

writer.notes: Legacy writer table, when present, is compared against data/writers.json.

writers.notes: Alternative writer table naming retained for discovery.

genre.notes: Legacy genre lookup compared with data/genre.json.

genres.notes: Alternative genre table naming retained for discovery.

user.notes: Legacy application-user data is outside the historical CBS RMT catalog domain and is not migrated by default.
